component.name: Loft
component.summary: Your NAS folders in ~/Loft, through your own Loft gateway
NAS-mappene dine i ~/Loft, gjennom din egen Loft-gateway

description.p: Loft shows the folders on your NAS in ~/Loft. Files are fetched when you open them and uploaded when you save them, at home and away, through a small Loft gateway you run yourself. Nothing is stored anywhere else.
Loft viser mappene på NAS-en din i ~/Loft. Filene hentes når du åpner dem og lastes opp når du lagrer, hjemme og borte, gjennom en liten Loft-gateway du kjører selv. Ingenting lagres noe annet sted.
